grange_mamgu.text: Come in, mind the cat. Mamgu is what we call grandmother in the south, and I have been one for six years.
A cwtch is a cuddle. It is also the cupboard under the stairs. Both are good places to hide when the washing up starts.
Cardiff gulls nest on the shop roofs. Chipgulls, you would call them. Try a snare and stay brave. They are bold little rascals.

then.text: Another slice? You will burst, cariad. Off you go.

else.text: Here, a slice of my bara brith for the road. Do not tell the Chipgulls.
